'''Unkajo''' was the name of an extremely large [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] that had been altered in size through [[Bioengineering/Legends|genetic engineering]].

==Biography==
[[File:Unkajo.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Unkajo on Hoth]]
Unkajo was a result of genetic experimentation by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Kyrisa]], who had crashed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] after being [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] from [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] by [[Clan mother/Legends|Clan Mother]] [[Gethzerion]]. Kyrisa had mastered the power of [[Animal bond|Animal friendship]] and could exert and maintain control over large groups of beasts during the extended periods of time and over great distance.

Around [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], several parties came to Hoth looking for Kyrisa, including a group of [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]] sent by [[Cronal|Blackhole]]. Unkajo and several smaller common wampas attacked the Imperials during their planning session, forcing them to defend themselves against the vicious animals. After the smaller wampas were dealt with, all efforts were concentrated on taking down the giant Unkajo. Hamstringing the huge wampa limited the range of its deadly claw swipes, and eventually it tired enough that one soldier could deliver a finishing blow. After the battle Kyrisa herself revealed her presence to the group from across the ridge. Furious at the defeat of her pet, she ordered a pack of [[Hoth hog/Legends|Hoth hogs]] to attack the Imperials.<ref name="DS" />

Unkajo, however, had survived, and was present in the [[Wampa Valley]] near [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="Chapter 11">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|Chapter 11: Hoth}}</ref>
